title: Zigzag
statementMd:
The court wizard Zigzag wants to become a famous mathematician. For that, he needs his own theorem, like the Cauchy theorem, or his sum, like the Minkowski sum. But most of all he wants to have his sequence, like the Fibonacci sequence, and his function, like the Euler's totient function.

The Zigag's sequence with the zigzag factor z is an infinite sequence $*S*_{*i*}^{*z*}$ $(*i* ≥ 1; *z* ≥ 2)$, that is determined as follows:

- $*S*_{*i*}^{*z*} = 2$, when ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/51bbc88da75b54dcdcb2c2613259cdb7dabe1294.png);
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3fc20322d0b5ffae1c3d0284a12bf23e11eaf17a.png), when ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/461f79f84094b56b6e5513c1f92583def26c2f82.png);
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4dc72e713993d7ff03be2790751dfc0516c1e2b9.png), when ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bb9c23fd7526e8b8019832016ef7e229963b5f2b.png).

Operation ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f58f159973d4609d919286c1821e69cd34d81118.png) means taking the remainder from dividing number $*x*$ by number $*y*$. For example, the beginning of sequence $*S*_{*i*}^{3}$ (zigzag factor 3) looks as follows: 1, 2, 3, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1.

Let's assume that we are given an array $*a*$, consisting of $*n*$ integers. Let's define element number $*i*$ $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*)$ of the array as $*a*_{*i*}$. The Zigzag function is function ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9d7bd279425165bd11f674f425aeec826f592718.png), where $*l*, *r*, *z*$ satisfy the inequalities $1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$, $*z* ≥ 2$.

To become better acquainted with the Zigzag sequence and the Zigzag function, the wizard offers you to implement the following operations on the given array $*a*$.

1. The assignment operation. The operation parameters are $(*p*, *v*)$. The operation denotes assigning value $*v*$ to the $*p*$-th array element. After the operation is applied, the value of the array element $*a*_{*p*}$ equals $*v*$.
2. The Zigzag operation. The operation parameters are $(*l*, *r*, *z*)$. The operation denotes calculating the Zigzag function $*Z*(*l*, *r*, *z*)$.

Explore the magical powers of zigzags, implement the described operations.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$ — The number of elements in array $*a*$. The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers: $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$ — the elements of the array.

The third line contains integer $*m*$ $(1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5})$ — the number of operations. Next $*m*$ lines contain the operations' descriptions. An operation's description starts with integer $*t*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 2)$ — the operation type.

- If $*t*_{*i*} = 1$ (assignment operation), then on the line follow two space-separated integers: $*p*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *n*; 1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$ — the parameters of the assigning operation.
- If $*t*_{*i*} = 2$ (Zigzag operation), then on the line follow three space-separated integers: $*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}, *z*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ *n*; 2 ≤ *z*_{*i*} ≤ 6)$ — the parameters of the Zigzag operation.

You should execute the operations in the order, in which they are given in the input.

## Output

For each Zigzag operation print the calculated value of the Zigzag function on a single line. Print the values for Zigzag functions in the order, in which they are given in the input.

Please, do not use the `%lld` specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is preferred to use `cin`, `cout` streams or the `%I64d` specifier.

## Note

Explanation of the sample test:

- Result of the first operation is $*Z*(2, 3, 2) = 3·1 + 1·2 = 5$.
- Result of the second operation is $*Z*(1, 5, 3) = 2·1 + 3·2 + 1·3 + 5·2 + 5·1 = 26$.
- After the third operation array $*a*$ is equal to $2, 3, 5, 5, 5$.
- Result of the forth operation is $*Z*(1, 5, 3) = 2·1 + 3·2 + 5·3 + 5·2 + 5·1 = 38$.
statementZhMd:
宫廷魔法师 Zigzag 想成为一名著名的数学家。为此，他需要拥有自己的定理，就像柯西定理一样；或者拥有自己的和，就像 Minkowski 和一样。但最重要的是，他想拥有自己的数列，就像 Fibonacci 数列一样，以及自己的函数，就像 Euler's totient function 一样。

带有之字形因子 $*z*$ 的 Zigag 数列是一个无限数列 $*S*_{*i*}^{*z*}$ $(*i* ≥ 1; *z* ≥ 2)$，其定义如下：

- 当 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/51bbc88da75b54dcdcb2c2613259cdb7dabe1294.png) 时，$*S*_{*i*}^{*z*} = 2$；
- 当 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/461f79f84094b56b6e5513c1f92583def26c2f82.png) 时，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3fc20322d0b5ffae1c3d0284a12bf23e11eaf17a.png)；
- 当 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bb9c23fd7526e8b8019832016ef7e229963b5f2b.png) 时，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4dc72e713993d7ff03be2790751dfc0516c1e2b9.png)。

运算 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f58f159973d4609d919286c1821e69cd34d81118.png) 表示用数 $*x*$ 除以数 $*y*$ 所得的余数。例如，数列 $*S*_{*i*}^{3}$（之字形因子为 3）的开头如下：1, 2, 3, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1。

现在，假设给定一个由 $*n*$ 个整数构成的数组 $*a*$。我们将数组的第 $*i*$ 个元素 $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*)$ 定义为 $*a*_{*i*}$。Zigzag 函数是函数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9d7bd279425165bd11f674f425aeec826f592718.png)，其中 $*l*, *r*, *z*$ 满足不等式 $1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$、$*z* ≥ 2$。

为了让你更加熟悉 Zigzag 数列和 Zigzag 函数，魔法师要求你在给定数组 $*a*$ 上实现以下操作。

1. 赋值操作。操作参数为 $(*p*, *v*)$。该操作表示将数组的第 $*p*$ 个元素赋值为 $*v*$。操作执行后，数组元素 $*a*_{*p*}$ 的值等于 $*v*$。
2. Zigzag 操作。操作参数为 $(*l*, *r*, *z*)$。该操作表示计算 Zigzag 函数 $*Z*(*l*, *r*, *z*)$。

探索之字形的魔法力量，实现上述操作。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$——数组 $*a*$ 中元素的数量。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的整数：$*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$——数组的元素。

第三行包含一个整数 $*m*$ $(1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5})$——操作的数量。接下来的 $*m*$ 行包含操作的描述。每个操作描述以整数 $*t*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 2)$ 开头——操作类型。

- 如果 $*t*_{*i*} = 1$（赋值操作），则该行接下来包含两个以空格分隔的整数：$*p*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *n*; 1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$——赋值操作的参数。
- 如果 $*t*_{*i*} = 2$（Zigzag 操作），则该行接下来包含三个以空格分隔的整数：$*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}, *z*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ *n*; 2 ≤ *z*_{*i*} ≤ 6)$——Zigzag 操作的参数。

你应按照输入中给出的顺序执行这些操作。

## 输出格式

对于每个 Zigzag 操作，在单独的一行中输出 Zigzag 函数的计算结果。按照输入中给出的顺序输出各个 Zigzag 函数的值。

请不要在 C++ 中使用 `%lld` 格式说明符读写 64 位整数。建议使用 `cin`、`cout` 流，或使用 `%I64d` 格式说明符。

## 说明

样例测试解释：

- 第一个操作的结果为 $*Z*(2, 3, 2) = 3·1 + 1·2 = 5$。
- 第二个操作的结果为 $*Z*(1, 5, 3) = 2·1 + 3·2 + 1·3 + 5·2 + 5·1 = 26$。
- 第三个操作执行后，数组 $*a*$ 变为 $2, 3, 5, 5, 5$。
- 第四个操作的结果为 $*Z*(1, 5, 3) = 2·1 + 3·2 + 5·3 + 5·2 + 5·1 = 38$。
